description.value: Keeps four pits of a culture her household has divided eleven times, and in 2291 gave a share of it to the expedition, which made the expedition kin and produced a four-year ethics review that she followed with interest through three separate interpreters. The share is kept alive at the sector station and is fed on a rota by whoever is wintering over. She declined a photograph until the kinship question was settled, and by the time it was settled the ship had gone.

formOfAddress: by name and then the culture's name

notes.value: The rota is pinned inside the vent laboratory at the sector station and is the only document in this galaxy that has never been late.
